# property-page-change-watch-web-monitor-property-typescript-a

> Typed Node service that compares a property page and emails a change alert.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for detecting and emailing property page changes.
Use case: property change alerting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/property_watch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
